sources.name: SILOS simulated demo dataset (mock /api/v1 routes)
sources.authority: Hand-authored for the SILOS hackathon demo (this repository)
sources.endpoint: app/api/v1 (Next.js route handlers) backed by lib/silos/mock

validation.evidence: Deterministic scripted timeline; shapes hand-drawn on real Eaton Fire / Altadena geography and reviewed for internal consistency (vulnerability summaries match sector details).

limitations: Fire boundary, spread prediction, sector polygons, vulnerability percentages, and feed events are demo fixtures, not official data (irregular GIS-style polygons, not grid cells).
Real responder-org names appear for authenticity, but all messages and claims are scripted fiction and labeled simulated in the UI.
Facility markers use generic descriptors, not real named businesses.
Contract mirror for the real backend: swapping in live data must not change response shapes (see lib/silos/types.ts).

sources.name: Building Outline (2023) — LARIAC (local GeoJSON clip)

validation.evidence: Clipped Eaton/Altadena/Pasadena AOI (-118.185,34.148,-118.055,34.235); ~102.5k unique footprints extracted from PMTiles z16, then filtered to ~46.8k (area≥45m², height≥5m). Runtime preloads public/gis/buildings.geojson once (no tile streaming).

limitations: Subset only — not county-wide LARIAC. Rebuild with: npm run build:buildings
Tiny auxiliary footprints removed for demo GPU budget; HEIGHT defaults (~6.5 m) when source null.
No runtime dependency on ArcGIS / OSM; basemap tiles remain remote (CARTO).

sources.name: Maximum Extent Evacuation Zones - LA County Fires 2025

validation.evidence: Feature layer metadata and 368 records were retrieved; 137 records are associated with EATON.

limitations: Represents zones that reached Warning or Order at any time, not timestamped status snapshots.
The most_extreme_status field is the highest alert level assigned to each zone.
The item notes manual visual verification and geometry adjustments.

sources.name: Investigation Report of the Eaton Fire Evacuation Alerts

validation.evidence: The official PDF returned HTTP 200 on 2026-07-23.

limitations: Use only alert times and zones explicitly supported by the report.
Reconstructed checkpoints must be labeled as historical reconstruction.

sources.name: California Active Evacuation Zones
sources.authority: California Governor's Office of Emergency Services

validation.evidence: Feature layer metadata and evacuation-zone fields were retrieved.

limitations: This is a current active-zone aggregation, not a historical archive.
County-issued information remains the authoritative source.

sources.name: CA Perimeters CAL FIRE NIFC FIRIS public view
limitations: Perimeters can be preliminary and can change after review.
The service is not an evacuation-order source.

sources.name: National Weather Service API

validation.evidence: The Eaton-area point request resolved to grid LOX/163,50 and an hourly forecast endpoint.

limitations: Requests must include a descriptive User-Agent with contact information.
Forecast data must retain its issuance and update times.

sources.name: American Community Survey 5-Year Data API

validation.evidence: A keyless request returned HTTP 302 with X-DataWebAPI-KeyError on 2026-07-23.

limitations: ACS 5-year estimates are not real-time population counts.
Margins of error must be retained and shown for selected indicators.

sources.name: Sentinel-2 L2A COGs via Element84 Earth Search STAC

validation.evidence: On 2026-07-25 the risk pipeline retrieved pre/post-fire scenes S2B_11SLT_20241218 and S2C_11SLT_20250221 (6 bands, 20 m) for the Palisades/Eaton AOI.

limitations: Scenes with processing baseline >= 04.00 carry a -1000 BOA offset that the pipeline subtracts.
Cloud cover and scene footprints limit usable acquisition dates.

sources.name: NOAA HRRR-Smoke archive (AWS Open Data, via Herbie)

validation.evidence: On 2026-07-25 the pipeline fetched MASSDEN (8 m near-surface smoke) analyses for six timestamps on 2025-01-08/09 and averaged them over the LA AOI.

limitations: Model analysis fields, not ground-station PM2.5 observations.
Values must not be presented as measured air quality or medical guidance.

sources.name: CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index 2022 (census tract)

validation.evidence: On 2026-07-25 the pipeline downloaded 2,495 LA County tracts (STCNTY='06037') with RPL_THEMES via paginated GeoJSON queries.

limitations: RPL_THEMES = -999 marks undefined percentiles and is excluded from scoring.
2018-2022 ACS-based aggregate ranking, not real-time population data.

sources.name: Prithvi-EO-2.0-300M-BurnScars (pre-trained segmentation model)

validation.evidence: On 2026-07-25 zero-shot inference ran successfully, but the output failed a dNBR cross-check (12% agreement, grid tiling artifacts on Sentinel-2-assembled input); the deterministic dNBR mask is the recommended burn input.

limitations: Trained on HLS imagery; Sentinel-2-assembled stacks can mismatch its expected preprocessing.
Model output is a research artifact, never an official burn perimeter.
Pipeline gates model output behind a >=30% dNBR-agreement check.

sources.name: AirNow API

validation.evidence: An unauthenticated request returned HTTP 401 on 2026-07-23.

limitations: Observations and forecasts can change and are not medical diagnoses.
Health guidance must come from reviewed EPA/AirNow templates.
